dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.search.fixwholewordregex>
<!description: Ensures 'isWholeWord' is false if 'isRegExSearch' is true when constructing TextSearchPageInput.>
<!severity: WARNING>
new org.eclipse.search.internal.ui.text.TextSearchPageInput($textPattern, $isCaseSensitive, $isRegExSearchExpr, $isWholeWordExpr, $scope)
=>
new org.eclipse.search.internal.ui.text.TextSearchPageInput($textPattern, $isCaseSensitive, $isRegExSearchExpr, $isWholeWordExpr && !$isRegExSearchExpr, $scope)
;;
